teamFindings.finding: Final Munich report lists Ben Brown, Carlton Davis III and TreVeyon Henderson out; A.J. Brown and multiple depth pieces are questionable. Drake Maye and Morgan Moses were full.
Final Munich report lists Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed out. Jared Goff was full; the secondary and center losses remain combined replacement/cluster cases.
Patrick Mahomes and the primary skill players were full; Jaylon Moore and Peter Woods were DNP, but no final game designation was posted at the cutoff.
Zachariah Branch, Divine Deablo and Jawaan Taylor were DNP with several front-seven players limited; no final designation was posted at the cutoff.

Minnesota explicitly had not announced a starter. Kirk Cousins was the stated target, Kyler Murray remained DNP and Carson Wentz limited; practice participation and opponent expectation were not treated as starter confirmation.
Josh Jacobs, Sean Rhyan, Lukas Van Ness and Josh Whyle were DNP while multiple linemen were limited; no final game status was posted at the cutoff.
Jessie Bates, Jordan Davis and Bhayshul Tuten were DNP; multiple offensive-line and defensive-front players were limited. No final designation was posted at the cutoff.

Cody Barton, Anthony Hill Jr., Tony Pollard, Peter Skoronski and Carnell Tate were DNP; James Williams' reserve status was revalidated. No final designation or one-for-one workload solution was available.

Spencer Brown was DNP and Dion Dawkins, Alec Anderson, Christian Benford, Dalton Kincaid and Connor McGovern were limited; prior Josh Palmer reserve status remains current. No final designation was posted.
Jarvis Brownlee Jr., Harrison Phillips and Trevin Wallace were DNP; Garrett Wilson and other defenders were limited. No final designation was posted.
Malik Willis and Zach Sieler are on reserve/injured. Official club evidence confirms Kyle McCord is preparing for his first NFL start; Aaron Brewer and Chris Bell were DNP.
Multiple front-seven, tight-end and offensive-line players were DNP while Jonathan Taylor and the listed cornerbacks were full; no final designation was posted.
Bobby Okereke was DNP and several RB/OL/CB/front players were limited or full; no final designation or one-for-one replacement case was established.
Erik McCoy, CJ Donaldson and Christen Miller were DNP while multiple offensive linemen were limited; no final designation or disjoint OL allocation was available.
Azeez Al-Shaair, Marvin Harrison Jr., Brevin Jordan, Woody Marks and Keylan Rutledge were DNP; Will Anderson Jr. and Danielle Hunter were limited. No final designation was posted.

Cleveland officially confirmed Deshaun Watson will start after clearing the concussion protocol; the governed QB writer replaced the prior Shedeur Sanders binding. Remaining listed availability items lack final resolved replacements.

Puka Nacua and Jordan Whittington moved to reserve/injured; the practice report also listed multiple OL, TE and secondary DNPs. Matthew Stafford was full. Replacement distribution and cluster arithmetic remain unresolved.

Gardner Minshew and Michael Wilson moved to reserve/injured. Arizona officially named Carson Beck for his first NFL start; the governed QB writer used the labelled LOW-confidence frozen prior and preserved all non-QB layers.

Sam Darnold remained ruled out and Drew Lock remained the expected starter already represented by the governed binding. Multiple OL/DL players were DNP, so no duplicate QB event or manual cluster move was created.
The official report listed only limited/full participation for the current entries; no final designation or material replacement case was established.
Gracen Halton's reserve status was revalidated; Mike Evans, Renardo Green and Deommodore Lenoir were DNP and several other defenders were limited. The secondary/front context remains a cluster.
Multiple skill, safety, pass-rush and corner entries were DNP while several others were limited; no final designation or distinct replacement allocation was posted.
Cameron Heyward was DNP and T.J. Watt limited; no final designation was posted and no distinct replacement case was established.
Jonathan Allen and Kyle Dugger were DNP and B.J. Hill limited; no final designation or disjoint replacement allocation was posted.
The Monday-game initial report listed multiple pass-rush, OL, WR and DB DNP/limited entries. Those are early-week practice classifications, not final availability.

Baltimore officially finalized the Jacoby Brissett trade and stated he was slated to start Monday. The governed writer replaced Joe Fagnano with Brissett while preserving the Lamar Jackson baseline and non-QB layers.
